desc: Analyze the state stored in systemd-oomd
r: oomctl may be used to get information about the various contexts read in by the systemd(1) userspace out-of-memory (OOM) killer, systemd-oomd(8).

The following commands are understood:

dump
Show the current state of the cgroups and system contexts stored by systemd-oomd.

The following options are understood:

-h, --help
Print a short help text and exit.
--version
Print a short version string and exit.
--no-pager
Do not pipe output into a pager.
On success, 0 is returned, a non-zero failure code otherwise.
u:
The following commands are understood:

dump
Show the current state of the cgroup(s) and system context(s) stored by systemd-oomd.
